limitations: Independent legacy 32-entry/8 MiB charged-serialization budget, separate from the content cache budget. It does not bound total heap, referenced binding internals, concurrent miss allocation or provider JSON parsing/validation.

Mutable hits incur structuredClone work and transient memory, not parse/validation/I/O. Depth, node, descriptor, cycle, exotic and byte admission guards are uncached-return safeguards, not rejection of otherwise valid documents. No native or whole-path latency/SLO measurement.

Expiry is opportunistic. Logical plus wall checks are local safeguards; original in-flight reads may return their original value/null. Global epochs conservatively suppress unrelated pending fills while retaining unrelated residents.
